A small working sheet: builds a column from this record's own title
words, then runs SUM, AVERAGE, MAX, MIN, and COUNT over it."""
import hashlib
QUERY_WORDS = 'spreadsheet service field guide index'
TITLE = "The Spreadsheet Service Field Guide Index"
def words_of(text):
    return [w.strip(".,:;()'").lower() for w in text.split() if len(w.strip(".,:;()'")) > 3]
VALUES = [len(w) for w in words_of(TITLE)]
def cell_sum(vals):
    return sum(vals)
def cell_average(vals):
    return sum(vals) / len(vals) if vals else 0
def cell_max(vals):
    return max(vals) if vals else 0
def cell_min(vals):
    return min(vals) if vals else 0
def cell_count(vals):
    return len(vals)
print("Spreadsheet Service grid demo - record 24: The Spreadsheet Service Field Guide Index")
print("Column values (word lengths): " + ", ".join(str(v) for v in VALUES))
print("SUM: %d" % cell_sum(VALUES))
print("AVERAGE: %.2f" % cell_average(VALUES))
print("MAX: %d" % cell_max(VALUES))
print("MIN: %d" % cell_min(VALUES))
print("COUNT: %d" % cell_count(VALUES))
joined = "|".join(str(v) for v in VALUES)
h = hashlib.sha256(joined.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
